description: This file implements timer management functions for CWMP, including starting, stopping, and handling timer callbacks, with internal linked list management of timers.

methods.name: timer_find
methods.description: Finds a timer by its name in the internal list.

methods.name: timer_find_by_addr
methods.description: Finds a timer by its timer address.

methods.name: timer_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a timer.

methods.name: timer_remove
methods.description: Removes a timer from the list by name.

methods.name: cwmp_timer_remove_all
methods.description: Removes all timers from the list.

methods.name: timer_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles timer expiration, calls the associated callback, and removes one-shot timers.

methods.name: timer_append
methods.description: Appends a timer to the internal list.

methods.name: cwmp_timer_start
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified wait and interval times, and callback handler.

methods.name: cwmp_timer_remainingTime
methods.description: Returns remaining time for a timer by name.
